messages.subject: syntax highlighting in knitr/Rnw documents
messages.body_plain:
In Rnw documents that combine latex and R code it is frequently necessary (or convenient) to refer
to objects with the R/S convention A$x but this seems to wreck havoc with syntax highlighting since
from a latex perspective there are unmatched $$.  I've been wondering whether there is a way to
overcome this, since such offending objects only occur in R code chunks or Sexpr expressions.

messages.body_snippet: It's returning omnifunc=htmlcomplete#CompleteTags.

messages.subject: Re: Omnicomplete in Rmarkdown Coding Chunks
messages.body_plain:
The code below in my vimrc solved the problem with rnoweb (I use vimtex):

if has("nvim")
  autocmd FileType rnoweb let b:rplugin_nonr_omnifunc="vimtex#complete#omnifunc" | setlocal omnifunc=CompleteR
else
  autocmd FileType rnoweb let b:rplugin_nonr_omnifunc="vimtex#complete#omnifunc" | setlocal omnifunc=rcomplete#CompleteR
endif

You could try the following in your vimrc:

if has("nvim")
  autocmd FileType rmd let b:rplugin_nonr_omnifunc="htmlcomplete#CompleteTags" | setlocal omnifunc=CompleteR
else
  autocmd FileType rmd let b:rplugin_nonr_omnifunc="htmlcomplete#CompleteTags" | setlocal omnifunc=rcomplete#CompleteR
endif

This way you should get html completion outside R chunks and R completion inside them.
